import sys, pathlib; sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
import pytest
from iban import iban_cozumle

def _gecerli_iban(banka_kodu="12345", yedek="0", hesap_no="1234567890123456"):
    bban = banka_kodu + yedek + hesap_no
    mod = int(bban + "292700") % 97
    kontrol = 98 - mod
    return f"TR{kontrol:02d}{bban}"

def _mod97_gecerli_mi(iban: str) -> bool:
    temiz = "".join(iban.split()).upper()
    birlesik = temiz[4:] + temiz[:4]
    sayisal = ""
    for ch in birlesik:
        if ch.isdigit():
            sayisal += ch
        else:
            sayisal += str(ord(ch) - 55)
    return int(sayisal) % 97 == 1

def test_normal_cozumleme():
    iban = _gecerli_iban("12345", "0", "1234567890123456")
    sonuc = iban_cozumle(iban)
    assert sonuc["banka_kodu"] == "12345"
    assert sonuc["yedek_hane"] == "0"
    assert sonuc["hesap_no"] == "1234567890123456"

def test_bosluklu_iban():
    iban = _gecerli_iban("12345", "0", "1234567890123456")
    bosluklu = " ".join(iban[i:i+4] for i in range(0, len(iban), 4))
    sonuc = iban_cozumle(bosluklu)
    assert sonuc["banka_kodu"] == "12345"
    assert sonuc["yedek_hane"] == "0"
    assert sonuc["hesap_no"] == "1234567890123456"

def test_kucuk_harf():
    iban = _gecerli_iban("54321", "0", "9876543210987654")
    sonuc = iban_cozumle(iban.lower())
    assert sonuc["banka_kodu"] == "54321"
    assert sonuc["yedek_hane"] == "0"
    assert sonuc["hesap_no"] == "9876543210987654"

def test_farkli_degerler_dilimleme():
    iban = _gecerli_iban("00061", "0", "0000000000000001")
    sonuc = iban_cozumle(iban)
    assert sonuc["banka_kodu"] == iban[4:9]
    assert sonuc["yedek_hane"] == iban[9]
    assert sonuc["hesap_no"] == iban[10:26]

def test_uzunluk_hatasi():
    iban = _gecerli_iban()
    kisa = iban[:-1]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle(kisa)

def test_mod97_hatasi():
    iban = _gecerli_iban()
    son = iban[-1]
    yeni_son = "0" if son != "0" else "1"
    bozuk = iban[:-1] + yeni_son
    if _mod97_gecerli_mi(bozuk):
        bozuk = iban[:-2] + ("00" if iban[-2:] != "00" else "11")
        assert not _mod97_gecerli_mi(bozuk)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle(bozuk)

def test_yedek_hane_sifir_degil():
    iban = _gecerli_iban("12345", "1", "1234567890123456")
    assert _mod97_gecerli_mi(iban)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle(iban)

def test_bos_iban():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle("")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle("   ")

def test_tr_olmayan_iban():
    iban = _gecerli_iban()
    yabanci = "DE" + iban[2:]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iban_cozumle(yabanci)

def calistir(args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)] + args, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', cwd=str(WORKDIR))
